Offshore Waters Forecast
NWS Ocean Prediction Center Washington DC
325 AM EST Sun Nov 8 2026

West central North Atlantic continental shelf and slope waters
beyond 60 nm to 250 nm offshore, including south of Georges Bank
from 1000 fm to 250 nm offshore.

Seas given as significant wave height, which is the average
height of the highest 1/3 of the waves. Individual waves may be
more than twice the significant wave height.

Locally higher winds and seas can be expected in and near tstms.

ANZ899-082030-
325 AM EST Sun Nov 8 2026

.SYNOPSIS FOR MID ATLC WATERS...A high pressure ridge will build
E and SE over the S portion today into tonight, and persist into
Mon. A series of low pressure troughs or weak cold fronts will 
cross the northern and central waters tonight into Mon night. 
High pressure will briefly build into the waters Tue and Tue 
night. A cold front will move through the northern waters Wed and
then stall over the N and central waters Wed night into Thu. Low
pressure will form along the front over the northern waters Thu 
night. 

$$
